title: Payment Service Gateway Timeout
description: Stripe gateway timeout during checkout flow.
resolution: Switched Stripe API endpoints to secondary region and updated timeout configurations to 15s.

title: Redis Connection Pool Exhausted
description: Redis connection pool reached limit of 500 active connections in payment service.
resolution: Increased max connection pool size to 1000 and optimized idle client eviction time.

title: Token Validation Latency Spike
description: Latency in parsing JWT token spiked to 350ms in authentication service.
resolution: Implemented token verification cache with redis to avoid public key fetch latency.

title: Database Connection Refused
description: PostgreSQL instance refused connection from gateway server.
resolution: Restarted PostgreSQL service replica and cleaned zombie backend threads.

title: API Gateway Rate Limit Triggered
description: API Gateway began rate limiting standard users due to misconfigured Ingress controller rules.
resolution: Updated Ingress rate limit annotations and reloaded Nginx configurations.

title: Database Query Table Scan
description: Unindexed query on transactions table caused CPU spike to 98%.
resolution: Added composite index on user_id and status columns of transactions table.

title: Payment Verification Webhook Failure
description: Adyen payment notification webhook failed with 500 error code.
resolution: Fixed parsing logic for Adyen payload webhook controller to handle null value in metadata.

title: Auth Database Locked
description: SQLite database file locked error during high volume user registration.
resolution: Migrated auth tables to primary PostgreSQL database and increased query timeout.

title: API Gateway CORS Policy Block
description: Cross-Origin requests blocked for subdomain API after CDN deployment.
resolution: Added explicit CORS allowed origin headers to CDN endpoint profile settings.

title: Database Disk Space Full
description: PostgreSQL transaction logs filled database disk storage capacity.
resolution: Cleared old log archives and enabled automatic pg_wal cleanup settings.

title: Double Charge on Checkout Flow
description: Concurrent checkout requests from same client caused double charges.
resolution: Implemented redis distributed lock key based on cart ID to block concurrent requests.

title: LDAP Sync Failures
description: Active Directory login sync failed in auth service due to expired credentials.
resolution: Rotated LDAP bind credentials in secret manager and forced AD sync task reload.

title: Gateway TLS Handshake Errors
description: Clients failed to connect due to TLS handshake timeout at Load Balancer.
resolution: Updated cipher suite configurations on Cloudflare and disabled deprecated TLS versions.

title: Payment Refund Job Stalled
description: Celery task scheduler failed to trigger refund jobs queue.
resolution: Restarted RabbitMQ broker container and purged corrupted tasks queue.

title: Database Row Locking Contention
description: Deadlock detected on inventory table update during sales event.
resolution: Optimized transaction order sequences and shortened database lock scopes.

title: User Logout Invalidation Failures
description: JWT tokens remained valid after explicit user logout.
resolution: Added logout token blacklist store in redis with TTL corresponding to token age.

title: Gateway Subsystem Memory Leak
description: NGINX controller worker processes restarted continuously due to memory limits.
resolution: Updated Lua configuration scripts in ingress controller to release unused tables.

title: Read Replica Replication Lag
description: Replication lag on analytics replica spiked to 45 minutes.
resolution: Adjusted max_wal_senders and hot_standby_feedback settings on DB replica configurations.

title: Auth MFA Callback Failures
description: Twilio SMS callbacks failed for MFA validation routes.
resolution: Updated Twilio SDK client configuration to support payload fallback webhook channels.

title: Gateway Static Asset Invalidation Failure
description: Users received cached older frontend bundle after hotfix release.
resolution: Triggered manual CDN purge for index.html cache route.
